payload.name: CaptureStatedPurposeBehindCreativeWork
payload.description: When a user explains the reason, purpose, or inspiration behind a creative work they made, extract a memory recording that stated purpose.
content: During candidate extraction, if a user explains what their creative work (e.g., drawing, writing, music) is for or why they made it, create a state or preference memory with the user as subject, the creative work as object, and the stated purpose as the value.
Treat the user's own explanation as authoritative unless contradicted elsewhere; do not infer additional purposes beyond what they state.

solves: The diagnosed failure is that the extraction stage produced no memory when a user explained the purpose behind a creative artifact (drawings) in a conversational reply. The abstract mechanism is that explanatory purpose statements following a compliment or direct question are often overlooked during candidate extraction. This skill applies to any future session where a user states why they created something or what it helps them achieve, ensuring the stated purpose is captured as a durable memory.
